llm.summary: This is a local-only note and document collection web app whose file handling is disclosed and aligned with its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: Use of localStorage, IndexedDB, FileReader, clipboard copy, drag-and-drop, and generated downloads is proportionate for a local document collection/export tool; no network exfiltration APIs were observed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No executable install script or dependency installation is required; the main artifact is a static HTML file opened in a browser.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The app accepts and locally stores several document formats selected or dragged in by the user; this is disclosed in the skill, though users should understand that uploaded file blobs persist in browser storage until deleted.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Notes, drafts, trash, folder metadata, images, and uploaded original file blobs persist locally in browser storage; this persistence is disclosed and user-directed, but users should manage deletion for sensitive files.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill describes a single-file front-end app for collecting text, managing images, organizing documents in folders, and exporting Word files; the inspected HTML implements those capabilities without unrelated behavior.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install/use this only if you are comfortable with notes, images, and uploaded documents being retained in the browser profile's local storage. Avoid adding highly sensitive documents on shared devices, and use the app's delete/clear controls plus browser site-data clearing if you need stronger removal.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: The foldered local file repository is not hidden in the artifact: SKILL.md and the product intro explicitly advertise folder-based document archiving, upload/drag-and-drop, preview/copy/download/delete, and IndexedDB blob storage.
[SDI-2] expected: The broad document type support and local blob retention are disclosed and fit the archive feature; the residual risk is local persistence of sensitive user-selected files, not evidence of deception or exfiltration.
